meta.title: ReelForge
meta.description: Turns a novel into per-chapter short dramas inside DSH: context bible, 10 asset classes, reference assembly, five generation kinds across local and cloud, per-chapter delivery with three-level rollback.

workbench.title: ReelForge Workbench
workbench.subtitle: Chapters, shots, assets, context, skills, output, log
workbench.chapterUnit: One chapter is one independently deliverable episode.

ui.flow.runmode.title: Run position

ui.flow.runmode.sectionNote: Local and cloud run the same kinds — the difference is where it runs and whether it costs
ui.flow.runmode.local.pro3: Retry as often as you like
ui.flow.runmode.local.con1: Needs a discrete GPU with 8G VRAM
ui.flow.runmode.local.con3: Speed is limited by your hardware
ui.flow.runmode.cloudSubtitle: Runs hosted workflows, billed per run
ui.flow.runmode.cloud.pro1: Works out of the box, no GPU
ui.flow.runmode.providerReadonly: The provider comes from the plugin config: the panel cannot change it, and a change here would not take effect.
ui.flow.runmode.compare.kindsValue: Local and cloud both support t2i / i2i / r2v / tts / music
ui.flow.runmode.compare.diffValue: Two sourceFile sets per kind: your own workflow vs a hosted one
ui.flow.runmode.compare.costValue: Local has no per-run fee · cloud is billed per run
ui.flow.runmode.compare.limitValue: Local is bound by VRAM and CK version · cloud is bound by queue and quota
ui.flow.runmode.switchable: You can switch position at any time: it only affects shots that are not generated yet. Existing storyboards and reference images are not re-run and are not billed twice.
ui.flow.runmode.footerHint: Not sure? Cloud can be switched at any time; local has to pass the device check first
ui.flow.runmode.footerValue: Probe whether this machine can generate locally
ui.flow.device.title: Device check

ui.flow.device.tableNote: Each probe maps to design §7.1; too little VRAM is stated, never silently downgraded
ui.flow.device.conclusionTitle: This machine cannot run the current plan. The gaps:
ui.flow.device.onlyImage: Run up to the image stage
ui.flow.device.bottomNote: Each probe maps to design §7.1; too little VRAM is stated, never silently downgraded
ui.flow.device.vramHint: {have}GB VRAM is below the {need}GB gate for the video stage: no automatic split — the shortfall is stated, and you can run llm + image only
ui.flow.device.footerValue: Derive the execution path from the probe results
ui.flow.plan.title: Execution path
ui.flow.plan.subtitle: Which generation mode, on which machine
ui.flow.plan.mappingNote: Local and cloud are two sourceFile sets of the same kind, not two tiers of capability
ui.flow.plan.scoreLabel: Auxiliary score (does not pick the path, only fine-tunes)
ui.flow.plan.scoreMissing: There is no scorer yet: this block takes no part in the decision — the matrix does.
ui.flow.plan.bottomNote: The score is a reference; the execution matrix decides
ui.flow.plan.needPosition: Pick the run position (local or cloud) first, then the kind.
ui.flow.stages.title: Execution stages
ui.flow.stages.subtitle: Four stages, selectable per chapter
ui.flow.stages.llm.sub: Write the character bible / style guide / shot breakdown / video prompts
ui.flow.stages.llm.hint: Needs the LLM channel · burns no render time
ui.flow.stages.image.sub: Character / scene / prop reference images + costume and age variants
ui.flow.stages.image.hint: Produces the reference images for the later stages
ui.flow.stages.tts.sub: Voice samples, only for speaking roles
ui.flow.stages.tts.hint: Soft dependency: missing voices silently degrade the video — the UI marks it
ui.flow.stages.video.sub: Shot by shot → self-review retry → score → compose → subtitles
ui.flow.stages.video.hint: Hard dependency on image: no reference image is an error
ui.flow.stages.readonly: The stage switches come from the plugin config: the panel has no write tool for them, so it is read-only.
ui.flow.stages.vramNote: No automatic split: too little VRAM is stated, and you can run llm + image only
ui.flow.stages.byChapterLabel: Per chapter (overrides the global setting above)
ui.flow.stages.noChapter: No chapters yet, so there is nothing to set per chapter.
ui.flow.stages.bottomNote: Stages always run in a fixed order, not in the order you tick them
ui.flow.stages.footerValue: Prepare the consistency anchors (character bible and style)
ui.flow.degrade.title: Degradation & failure
ui.flow.degrade.subtitle: Say what is missing, never pretend it worked
ui.flow.degrade.failed: The degradation state could not be read
ui.flow.degrade.matrixNote: Soft dependency loss is stated too: a missing voice only degrades, it is not an error
ui.flow.degrade.noneBody: Neither the probe nor the delivery found a gap.
ui.flow.degrade.dialogLabel: How it is phrased in chat
ui.flow.degrade.noNotices: No degradation phrasing yet: nothing missing, nothing to say.
ui.flow.degrade.footerLabel: Prefer an incomplete but honest result

ui.log.drifted: This record drifted; rolling back overwrites later changes
ui.log.projectLocked: The project layer cannot be rolled back: this plugin has no API to delete a project
